planner.title: Moonwood Crystal Guard
planner.objective: Protect the crystal at (680,240) with 3 health by building towers to defeat all six invaders before they reduce the crystal's health to zero.
acceptance: The game starts at a ready screen and begins immediately upon pressing Start, with calm synthesized pad music starting then.
Six invaders spawn in pairs at 0, 3, and 6 seconds at (40,240), moving straight at 40 pixels/second along a path with at most 16 markers.
Pressing J builds a tower at the next available site among (200,190), (360,190), and (520,190) if the player has at least 2 coins; the player starts with 6 coins.
Each tower automatically defeats one invader within 130 pixels every 0.5 seconds and adds 1 coin per kill.
The HUD displays crystal health (starts at 3), coins, and defeated invader count out of 6; building all three towers early results in a win, no towers results in a loss within 25s.
The game freezes on win (6 kills) or loss (crystal health zero); Restart resets the game state; pause, remappable controls, and separate music/SFX volume are supported; music plays

story.intro: Protect the crystal at (680,240) from six invaders by building towers at three sites using J. Each tower kills invaders nearby and earns coins.
story.victory: Your towers defended the crystal! All invaders defeated. Well done!
story.defeat: The crystal was destroyed. The invaders got through. Try building towers earlier.
